name: Fatima Institute for Global AI Research

projects.title: Curiosity-Driven Learning in LLM Agents (master’s thesis)
bullets: Studying curiosity-driven LLM exploration across inference, SFT, and GRPO.
Adapting Schmidhuber’s curiosity signals (surprisal, learning progress, information gain) to modern LLM agents.
Built CuriosityLab, an environment for clean signal ablations; adding learning progress raises exploration 1.5× (pilot).

projects.title: SpecDrift: Multilingual AI Safety
projects.mentor: Tasmiah Tahsin Mayeesha (UNT) and Md Kishor Morol (Anthropic)
bullets: Auditing whether Anthropic and OpenAI models follow their own published constitutions and specs.
Red-teaming with Petri using persona-based, multi-turn attacks across Bangla, Egyptian, and Sudanese contexts.
Designed tiered risk taxonomies for Egyptian dialects, including region-specific risks in Upper Egypt.

name: PRISM AI Safety Research Fellowship
bullets: Reproduced Meta’s LoRe and helped fix a data shortcut that had inflated its accuracy from 59% to 98%.
Developed Reward Basis Decomposition (RBD) to separate shared from individual preferences; per-user terms added no accuracy on real data.
Showed RBD recovers synthetic per-user preferences and beats the base reward model (0.64 → 0.67 accuracy).
Co-first author of a NeurIPS 2026 InterpScience workshop oral (1 of 4 from 267 submissions).

name: MIT AI Alignment
bullets: Studied alignment, scalable oversight, and mechanistic interpretability.
Weekly reading groups on reward misspecification, alignment faking, and AI threat models.

name: Medical Informatics & Neuro Dynamics (MIND) School
bullets: Developed an LSTM-CNN model for EEG seizure detection (99.1% test accuracy for 2-class, 90.7% for 5-class), co-authoring a paper in Knowledge-Based Systems.
Studied sycophancy in medical vision-language models, leading to a co-first-authored NeurIPS 2026 workshop paper.

name: Université Paris-Est Créteil
bullets: Built a 105K-record multilingual event dataset (real and synthetic) across English, French, and Tunisian Arabic.
Prototyped ensemble knowledge distillation from Jais 13B and TunBERT into TinyLlama 1.1B for on-device use.
